channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Execution Survivor Reports Ongoing Pain After Lethal Injection Attempt
item.description: Christa Pike, an American woman who survived a lethal injection attempt, has stated she is in constant pain a month after the incident. The details of her condition and the circumstances surrounding the failed execution were reported. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Teacher Recounts Tackling Gunman as School Reopens
item.description: An educator who tackled a gunman at a school in Bend, Oregon, has spoken about the incident, stating "It all happened so fast." The community is preparing to reopen the school. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: Ukraine's air raid alert system experienced "hostile interference" when its public alert application was hacked, causing it to send erroneous alerts, the Ukrainian air force announced. The interference affected the system's ability to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Director Michael Mann, known for the film 'Heat,' was injured in an accidental shooting at a gun range in Los Angeles. The incident involved an accidental weapon discharge. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: US election officials are facing scrutiny over voting site issues in rural Alaska, where lawsuits allege sites failed to open before Election Day. Concurrently, concerns are being raised about foreign threats to the electoral process, with… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Tribunal Indicts Delhi Police on Protest Handling
item.description: A people's tribunal has indicted the Delhi Police for its handling of a protest that occurred in July. The tribunal's findings specifically target the police's actions during the demonstration. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: An ex-civil servant has filed a petition in the Delhi High Court seeking reasons for the repeated deployment of the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) during protests in Delhi. The petition was filed by Ashish Joshi. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police bust counterfeit coin racket, four arrested
item.description: Delhi Police have busted a counterfeit coin racket and arrested four individuals. The operation resulted in the seizure of counterfeit ₹20 coins valued at approximately ₹1 lakh. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Delhi Police rescued a 13-year-old who had been kidnapped within three hours by using a Rs 5,000 UPI transfer to track the abductor. The operation involved sending the money via UPI to locate the kidnapper. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Mother and son die after fall from Pune high-rise; probe underway
item.description: A 33-year-old woman and her son died after falling from a high-rise building in Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune. Police are investigating the incident, which is being treated as a suspected suicide. A note was recovered from the scene. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee faces fresh bailable warrant in defamation case
item.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee has been issued a fresh bailable warrant in an eight-year-old defamation case filed by Vikas Pandey. A court in Gurugram has requested his address. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Sri Lankan Navy has detained seven fishermen from Tamil Nadu. The fishermen, hailing from Rameswaram and Thangachimadam, were apprehended near Katchatheevu. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant has stated that the Constitution should guide the judiciary when laws are silent on matters. He also called for introspection on improving the responsiveness of the judicial process. Separately, the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Rajasthan's Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) is investigating IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal and his wife, IPS officer Prashakha Mathur, in connection with a villa scam. The couple allegedly purchased 40 villas in two and a half years. As a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.description: The Kerala High Court has ordered the formation of a new expert panel to study the erosion issues related to the Vizhinjam port project. The court specified that the panel must ensure there is no conflict of interest among its members… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
